title: Two-dimensional Shear-Wave Elastography Evaluate Esophageal Varices Bleeding Risk of Liver Cirrhosis
brief_summary: The purpose of this retrospective study was to investigate the diagnostic performance of 2D-SWE for predicting the presence of esophageal varices and high-risk varices in patients with liver cirrhosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Cirrhosis were diagnosed by liver biopsy, CT and ultrasound before enrolled
* Age was 16-80

Exclusion Criteria:

* With bleeding history
* With EVL history, BRTO or TIPS history
* With NSBB history
* With ascites
* With splenectomy or splenic embolism, history
* With liver cancer
